about: credits engine style coin with a 10% team allocation held by the stack's ArtCoinsVaultV2: 7 day cliff, then 90 day linear vesting to the beneficiary. extensions[0].data is abi.encode(beneficiary, lockup, vesting) with the beneficiary the launcher placeholder (0x7ea5...0001), lockup 604800 and vesting 7776000 seconds (the contract minimums are 7 days and 90 days, the maximum 3650 days each). bps is the share of supply and must be nonzero; msgValue must be 0. Replace every placeholder (0x7ea5...0001) and set example to false before a broadcast.

fee.referralBpsNote: 0 turns referrals off. The coin admin can set it later, up to 100.

mev.note: startingSkimBps and windowSeconds are required when a mev module is set
